translations.web: Why should you be beaten more, that you revolt more and more? The whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.
translations.bsb: Why do you want more beatings? Why do you keep rebelling? Your head has a massive wound, and your whole heart is afflicted.
translations.kjv: Why should ye be stricken any more? ye will revolt more and more: the whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.
translations.asv: Why will ye be still stricken, that ye revolt more and more? the whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.
